name: paperpet
description: A quiet desktop reading companion for Zotero.

scripts.lint: eslint src test typings zotero-plugin.config.ts && prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs zotero-plugin.config.ts 'src/**/*.ts' 'test/**/*.ts' 'typings/**/*.ts' 'addon/**/*.{js,json,css}'
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src test typings zotero-plugin.config.ts --fix && prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs zotero-plugin.config.ts 'src/**/*.ts' 'test/**/*.ts' 'typings/**/*.ts' 'addon/**/*.{js,json,css}'
